assessment.explanation: UDGAM's own top-ranked suspect is MENUETT (563082600), the same vessel Cerulean's source candidates name -- at LOW confidence: it leads STENA PROSPEROUS by 3.0% of score (0.536 vs 0.520), on 4 of 7 measurable components. The margin used to run the other way. STENA led on a 142-minute NOAA transponder silence scored as darkness; merging in GFW's hourly presence layer showed the vessel transmitting inside that window at three separate hours, at positions inside the search box -- a receiver coverage hole, not evasion. Nulling that evidence (and the ~30-minute residual silence it left, which turned out to be bounded by a row with no speed-over-ground field) moved MENUETT to #1. This is reported as a defect fix with a target-shaped side effect: the coverage-hole reasoning was written down and measured before this case was re-scored, and would have been applied identically had it moved the ranking the other way.
assessment.what_would_have_helped: An identity-confidence component -- IMO-verified vs MMSI-only, cross-registry agreement -- would separate MENUETT from STENA PROSPEROUS on more than a 3% margin. The margin itself is a finding: our top two suspects differ by less than the noise in either score.
